{{Quote|In just one hour, we will jump into the Sepan sector to quell a long-standing civil war between the peoples of Ripoblus and Dimok.|[[Harkov]]|<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" />}}
The '''Sepan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kayuk]],<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref> [[Raskane IV]]<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> and [[Wann Tsir]],<ref name="CSWE-Wann Tsir">{{CSWECite|III|319|Wann Tsir}}</ref> as well as the location known as [[Tingel Deepspace Besh]].<ref name="TEA" /> The sector also contained the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]], which was the site of the planets [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]],<ref name="CSWE-Sepan system">{{CSWECite|III|139|Sepan system}}</ref> [[Gaerboud IV]],<ref name="XWvTF" /><ref name="Email 2">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2023_2.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2023-04-06}}</ref> [[Gerbaud 2]],<ref name="CSWE-Sepan system" /> [[Kuthard]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2015-06-30}}</ref> [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]] and [[Sepan 8]].<ref name="CSWE-Sepan system" />

The Sepan sector was home to the eponymous [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="TF" /> divided between the peoples of Dimok and Ripoblus,<ref name="CSWE-Sepan system" /> the two primary worlds of the Sepan system.<ref name="CSWE-Dimok">{{CSWECite|I|189|Dimok}}</ref><ref name="CSWE-Ripoblus">{{CSWECite|III|101|Ripoblus}}</ref>

The Sepan sector was the site of the [[Sepan Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] which lasted intermittently for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="HNN" /><ref name="TF" /><ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW" />
